title: They really photoshop out the texture in their photos
text:
They really photoshop out the texture in their photos. I definitely thought this was smooth based on the product photos but it’s actually very textured and I’m not sure now I feel about that yet.

I will need to edit once I’ve actually used it, assuming I don’t decide to return it first because of how rough the surface I have to hold feels.
